headline: Clinton order makes another change to the rules for an advisory committee on the public duties of digital TV broadcasters.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13038, which set up an advisory committee to study what public interest duties digital television broadcasters should have. The title says it is a further change to that earlier order. No summary was provided, so the exact change is not clear. Orders like this often extend a committee's deadline or adjust its membership, but that cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Advisory Committee on Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters
who_it_affects.how: The rules or terms that govern their committee are changed in some way not described in the title.
